text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone around me has been so supportive 
as the Oka Sho approaches. Even Sky-san 
came over to cheer me on! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! Now that I'm in the 
Classic Class, it feels like I've polished 
my speed enough to catch Sakura Bakushin 
O-san's eye!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr said she's "feeling the 
wind" too! Hearing it in her own unique 
words makes me so happy♪ I feel like I can 
give it my all in the Oka Sho now!
